REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 10/14/2026
Patient Name: Nora Parker
DOB: 02/08/1979
MRN: MRN-66503

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Mark Turner, Maple Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of intermittent palpitations.

Nora Parker is a 47-year-old woman with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. She has had intermittent episodes of a rapid, fluttering heartbeat over the past six weeks, lasting several minutes and occurring both at rest and with activity.

She denies fainting, chest discomfort, or shortness of breath. Please evaluate her intermittent palpitations and advise on further care.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Mark Turner
Maple Family Practice
